verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own Marketing Emails API lets a program create and update marketing emails, and the editor supports segment targeting and scheduled sends. A first-party campaign agent can also plan campaigns. However, nothing documents an agent setting the segment or schedule via API, or an explicit approval gate or queue where a human signs off before send. Missing for 10: documented approval/review workflow before send, API-level segment assignment and scheduling by an agent, evidence that agent-created drafts wait for human sign-off, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft a campaign against a segment and leave it scheduled or queued for a human to approve before send

citations.quote: You can use the Marketing Emails API to programmatically create, update, and get details about marketing emails.
You can set contacts and segments who will receive the email
schedule the email to send at a specific date and time
let campaign agent plan your entire campaign based on brand, audience, and past performance
